doc_proposal.placement: Action Server shared database acceptance guidance
doc_proposal.delta: For a bounded PostgreSQL migration API gate, force a real pending migration in a fresh task-owned fixture, then observe both independent workers waiting simultaneously on the production transaction advisory lock before releasing it. Record controller/backend/OS identities and compare the final columns, unique indexes, named migration rows and untouched fixture state with the fresh production schema. Keep source imports and prepared-toolchain manifest equality explicit when reusing an interpreter. Bound service and child operations, sanitize logs on failure as well as success, and require verified named-container absence and child reaping; a cleanup failure must remain a failing receipt. This gate proves the tested migrate_db boundary, not complete CLI startup or wheel/frozen/TLS/mixed-version recovery acceptance.
